Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated inventory/reward item icon for the Neo Tokyo pixel-art mobile RPG. Reference image 1 supplies the existing character's clothing proportions, simple pixel style and restrained shading ONLY: draw the requested ITEM ALONE, no person or mannequin. Genuine transparent background. Square canvas, single centered item, comfortable equal transparent margins; object large and readable at small inventory size. Aim for a simple 64x64 logical-pixel icon, enlarged with hard square pixel edges. Economical 3–5 flat shade steps per material, dark pixel outline, upper-right light, no smooth gradients, blur, photographic fabric detail or tiny pixel noise. Keep dark shadows navy rather than neutral pure black. No lettering, numbers, logos, rarity badge, card frame, floor, scenery or extra items.
Draw a PAIR of plain WHITE RUNNING SHOES as a common quest reward, based on the simple grey low-top trainers on the reference character. Three-quarter inventory view: one shoe slightly ahead, second partly behind, both clearly recognizable as a pair, toes angled gently to screen-right. Modest everyday runners, thick practical soles, a few simple lace marks, no brand or elaborate athletic technology. Off-white upper #E4E9F4 with cool blue-grey shadows #9FACC8 #6B7A9C; slightly darker light-grey sole, deep navy outlines #101118 #282B36. They should read WHITE, not dark grey. No legs, socks, feet, person, magical glow or pedestal.

Item: a worn simple dark NAVY BASEBALL CAP named Test MAX Cap. Three-quarter front inventory view, gently curved brim and soft fabric crown. Image 2 supplies the EXISTING Test MAX brand from the left storefront and its pill-bottle poster: reproduce that brand on the cap's front panel, reading exactly "Test MAX", preferably two compact stacked lines matching the reference's mixed-case Test and uppercase MAX. Plain block lettering in muted ice-blue so it reads clearly against the dark cap. No new brand typography, no extra slogan, no 4X branding and no bottle attached to the cap. Use a few broad navy fabric shades and a thin cool rim light; slightly worn, not shiny luxury headwear.

Instead of clothing, draw the universal COMMON quest reward CACHE: a squat, sturdy rectangular industrial metal chest, not a gift box or treasure barrel. Same pixel-art visual language as the reference. Neo Tokyo salvage-tech: battered navy metal panels, reinforced corners, a heavy fitted lid, simple hinges and a large central latch. Three-quarter view showing the front, top and right side. Short and wide, roughly 1.5 times as wide as tall, occupying about 75% of canvas width; entire chest including glow inside the margins. Closed lid with a VERY THIN luminous seam hinting at rewards inside.
Muted navy/steel body #101118 #1B1D27 #373B49 #4D5365, restrained cool metal edges #697287 #9FACC8. Common-tier light is faint SILVER/ICE-WHITE #E4E9F4: a thin lid seam, one small rectangular illuminated mark on the central latch, and a tiny localized halo made from a few stepped translucent pixel clusters immediately around the seam. It must stand out on a dark navy app surface without a big aura. Not a wooden fantasy pirate chest, not a military ammo crate, no weapons, gems, ribbons, floating loot, question marks or text. The simple core chest geometry will be reused for uncommon, rare and legendary tiers.

Edit the supplied COMMON quest reward cache into the requested rarity variant for the same Neo Tokyo pixel-art game. Preserve the exact core chest identity: same camera, front/top/right faces, perspective, closed lid, silhouette, dimensions, placement, dark navy steel panels, reinforced corners and latch. Keep the same square canvas and genuine transparent background. Do not redesign or rotate it. Hard square pixel clusters and economical shading, no blur, gradients, photographic detail or ornamental fantasy styling. The chest remains mostly dark navy metal. Change only small trim/inlay details, latch marks and the thin lid-seam glow to communicate the new tier. All glow is faint and localized, contained within the canvas; preserve the large transparent margins. No floor, background, labels, text, rarity words, ribbons, floating loot, gems or stars.

A slightly more visible but still faint stepped-pixel halo immediately around the seam; no large aura or particles. Same worn practical metal chest.
